Loss report: gitlab -> argo

[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.resource (the source runs on the events external, chat and its file has no trigger form for them; Argo has no event for them, and the file names no schedule to copy)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.schedule (the source runs on the events schedule and its file has no trigger form for them; Argo has no event for them, and the file names no schedule to copy)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.manual: argo submit --from workflowtemplate/gitlab-ci (start a run with: argo submit --from workflowtemplate/gitlab-ci; the Workflow object needs a ServiceAccount with the rights in .argo/rbac/)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.push: EventSource webhook secret (Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token must exist and match the GitHub webhook; the repository owner and name are placeholders; set them in the EventSource)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/2 trigger.tag: EventSource webhook secret (Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token must exist and match the GitHub webhook; the repository owner and name are placeholders; set them in the EventSource)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.env: copied into the env of every container (a step variable of the same name wins)
